title: How green is your money?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Do you know what environmental impact your bank or pension investments may have?
Should banks be required to tell customers exactly which industries their money supports?
Would you accept a slightly lower financial return for a clearly greener investment?
Can 'green finance' create real change, or is it sometimes just a marketing label?
If you discovered your savings were funding an industry you strongly opposed, would you move them?
